title: RegulatoryFeasibilityItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-vision-regulatory-feasibility-checker. This agent produces no separate document — items carry the FULL, authoritative rationale and mitigation narrative directly; there is no artifact to retrieve for more detail. Status, citation, id, and requires_legal_review are structural facts, not prose duplication, and stay in full. Every constraint is a primary category and MUST carry a citation. Every Amber/Red constraint MUST carry a mitigation or an explicit requires_legal_review flag — a Red constraint with no mitigation and requires_legal_review=false is an invalid output, not a stylistic gap.

rationale.description: Full rationale for the overall verdict — this is the only place this content lives, there is no separate document

source_reference.description: KB chunk id (e.g. kb-L2-domain-regulatory#allergen-labelling) or regulatory-db lookup reference

regulation.description: The specific named regulation/section — not prose, kept in full

name.description: Constraint name — short label, not prose, kept in full

rationale.description: Full rationale for this constraint's status — this is the only place this content lives, there is no separate document

mitigation.description: Full, concrete mitigation. Required (non-null) if status is Amber or Red, unless requires_legal_review is true. This is the only place this content lives, there is no separate document.

description.description: Full description of the open item — this is the only place this content lives, there is no separate document
